sources.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Original post-trained checkpoint: 30.5B total, 3.3B activated; Apache-2.0; thinking switch and tool example; 32,768 native context, 131,072 with YaRN.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 announcement names this original MoE model and its open-weight release; distinguishes post-trained and Base checkpoints.

sources.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B config.json
sources.evidence: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM; 48 layers, 128 experts, eight experts per token. Default max_position_embeddings=40960 and rope_scaling=null.

sources.title: Qwen3 official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies developer as Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud. News dates original Qwen3 release April 29, 2025; distinguishes July 2025 revisions.

sources.title: Alibaba Introduces Qwen3, Setting New Benchmark in Open-Source AI with Hybrid Reasoning
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 launch announcement identifies Alibaba as developer and the 30B/3B MoE variant as globally available.

name.note: Display spacing matches official Qwen3-30B-A3B identifier.

developer.note: Developed by Alibaba Cloud Qwen team.

family.note: Original Qwen3 generation of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official announced release date. Baseline catalog says April 28; no primary release announcement inspected supports that day.

open_weights.note: Announcement explicitly releases this checkpoint publicly.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported billions, including embeddings; 30B in name is rounded.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer explicitly reports activated billions; 3B is rounded.

architecture.note: Sparse decoder; 128 experts with eight selected per token.

context_window.note: Maximum requires YaRN; native trained context is 32,768. Default configuration limit is 40,960.

modalities.note: Text tokenizer and causal language model; no multimodal encoder.

reasoning.note: Original checkpoint supports enable_thinking mode switch.

tool_call.note: Agentic-use section provides this exact checkpoint in Qwen-Agent example.

description.value: Qwen3 mixture-of-experts text model with 30.5B total and 3.3B active parameters, switchable thinking mode, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces rounded active count and vague efficiency claim.

patch.description: Qwen3 mixture-of-experts text model with 30.5B total and 3.3B active parameters, switchable thinking mode, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Original April 2025 hybrid-thinking checkpoint. Context 131,072 requires YaRN; native context is 32,768. Release date follows official announcement; upstream catalog lists April 28.

summary: Corrects total/active counts to 30.5B/3.3B, supplies Apache-2.0, and uses April 29 official release date with catalog discrepancy recorded. Confirms MoE, text modalities, reasoning, tools and maximum context; qualifies YaRN requirement.
